user.name: Pushkar G R
user.bio: I build high-performance, low-level network infrastructure and distributed systems. From writing eBPF/XDP hooks in the kernel to engineering peer-to-peer transport protocols in Rust, my focus is on absolute zero-copy efficiency and secure, scalable telemetry.

projects.name: Aegis - Zero-Trust Network Controller
projects.description: High-performance distributed firewall leveraging eBPF/XDP for kernel-level packet filtering. Implemented LRU eviction for concurrent sessions and reduced map write contention by 90% via lazy timestamping.

projects.name: GhostLink - Serverless P2P Chat
projects.description: Decentralized chat application using a custom reliable-UDP transport layer (KCP). Features NAT hole-punching via STUN, end-to-end encryption using ChaCha20-Poly1305, and strictly peer-to-peer architecture.

projects.name: Deston - Rust Load Balancer
projects.description: High-performance HTTP load balancer with dynamic routing, built-in health monitoring, and fault tolerance capabilities. Features include connection pooling, and configurable retry policies for enhanced reliability in distributed environments.

projects.name: MotteSeed - BitTorrent Client
projects.description: Feature-complete BitTorrent client implementing the BitTorrent protocol with optimized peer communication, efficient disk I/O, and bandwidth management. Includes support for DHT, peer exchange, magnet links, and encryption for secure P2P file transfers.

projects.name: TurboTFTP - TFTP Implementation
projects.description: RFC 1350-compliant Trivial File Transfer Protocol (TFTP) implementation. Features non-blocking I/O, efficient block management, customizable timeouts, and robust error handling for reliable file transfers.

projects.name: NaviDir - Terminal File Manager
projects.description: Lightweight terminal-based file manager. Use keyboard to navigate with vim-like bindings. Designed to be fast and lightweight for efficient file system exploration.

projects.name: ByeByeMouse - Keyboard-First Navigation
projects.description: Firefox extension that transforms web browsing through comprehensive keyboard control, eliminating mouse dependency. Features link highlighting, vim-inspired command modes, and DOM traversal algorithms for seamless navigation.

projects.name: QuestionScraper - Competitive Programming Tool
projects.description: Go-based concurrent scraper for extracting programming problems from major competitive platforms. Implements rate-limiting, anti-detection mechanisms, and structured data extraction for creating comprehensive offline practice datasets with categorization.

projects.name: CopyCode - Browser Extension
projects.description: Firefox extension that streamlined code copying functionality.

projects.name: HumanBenchmark - Cognitive Assessment Platform
projects.description: Full-stack web application for measuring cognitive abilities and reaction times. Implements real-time performance tracking, statistical analysis of user metrics, responsive design, and algorithm-based challenge generation for comprehensive skill assessment.
